META_OAUTH_AND_ADS_GRAPH.bypass_secret: Create Facebook App (Business type) and keep in 'In Development' mode. Admin of App + Admin of Ad Account gets instant ads_read & business_management without App Review or Business Verification.

oauth_quirks.localhost_rewrite: Meta Development mode allows http://localhost:<port>/connect/oauth/callback without registration, but blocks 127.0.0.1. Always rewrite 127.0.0.1 -> localhost.
oauth_quirks.token_exchange_method: GET (with client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri, code) — no PKCE

META_PAGES_AND_MESSENGER.page_token_resolution: Calls GET /v25.0/me/accounts?fields=id,name,category,access_token,tasks using User Token to obtain per-Page access_token. Strips access_token from LLM-visible list output.

messenger_webhook.send_endpoint: POST https://graph.facebook.com/v23.0/me/messages (messaging_type='RESPONSE', max chunk 1900 chars, plain text)

multi_account_isolation.reason: Prevents ~/.zalo-agent-cli session overwrites when multiple sales staff connect personal Zalo accounts

dual_speed_polling.transport: Direct mcp_client.pool.call_tool(spec, 'zalo_get_messages', {'limit': 20}) bypassing mcp_hub audit log

group_utf16_mention_algorithm.problem: zca-js / Zalo Web calculates @mention offset & length in UTF-16 code units, not Python Unicode codepoints (4-byte emoji = 2 UTF-16 units).

platform_quirks.no_edit_or_delete: Cannot edit 'Thinking...' placeholder; must loop sendChatAction(action='typing') every 4s and send final message once.
platform_quirks.idle_poll_timeout_response: Returns {'ok': False, 'description': 'Request timeout'} on normal 30s idle poll — must filter ('request timeout', 'timeout', 'time out', '408') as normal empty poll.
platform_quirks.group_detection: chat_type == 'GROUP' or (not chat_type and chat_id != sender_id)
